name: editlens
description: See Claude's edits on your page as they happen: each change is highlighted, the chat and code appear next to the page, and Claude can run from the page.

start.title: What /editlens does
start.description: Run Claude from the panel on the page too (page control, the default), or only connect the page (Manual). With page control picked and Connect when Claude Code starts on, it also turns on by itself when a session starts and your page opens.
options: Connect and turn on page control
start.default: Connect and turn on page control

permission_mode.title: Page control: permission mode
permission_mode.description: How Claude asks before acting when you run it from the page: the mode page control starts in. The menu under the panel's message box changes it for the page control that runs now. Bypass is never a default.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: Claude's effort level for page messages and tasks it starts. Auto: the level Claude Code uses by itself (the one /effort saves, else its default). Max is never saved: pick it on the page or with /editlens effort max, for the page control session running now.

safety_check.title: Safety check
safety_check.description: Ask before Claude replaces most of a file or removes EditLens from your app.

remote_tasks.title: Paired computers can run Claude here
remote_tasks.description: A computer you paired with this one (/editlens pair) can ask Claude here to do tasks (each in its own copy of the project in a git project) and start page control here (/editlens control). They run in this computer's permission mode. Their permission questions appear in the EditLens panel, where a page can only deny; only you can allow them, in the EditLens window on this computer. Off blocks starting tasks, messaging or merging them, and page control; the paired computer can still list its tasks and copy files from this project.

paired_answers.title: Paired computers can answer questions here
paired_answers.description: A computer that joined this one (/editlens join) can allow or deny Claude's permission questions here, in its own EditLens window. Only questions about the paired project, and only a person clicking in that window. Turn it on here only: the paired computer and its page can't. Off: you answer on this computer.

task_account.title: Run paired computers' tasks as
task_account.description: Auto: on Linux, when Claude Code runs as root, tasks on a project sent from a paired computer run as the normal account editlens once /editlens task-user has set it up (without it, they run as root and say so). Root (unsafe): every task runs as root, which can change anything on this computer. It turns on only once you allow it in this computer's EditLens window.

tasks_at_once.title: Tasks at once
tasks_at_once.description: Each running task adds about 0.3–0.5 GB of memory and uses your plan's limits in parallel. Paired computers' tasks run on this computer, 1 to 8 at a time; more tasks wait for an available session. A change applies to the next task that starts, and running tasks keep running.

subagent_copies.title: Subagents work in their own copy
subagent_copies.description: In a git project, each subagent that can edit files works in its own copy of the project (a git worktree), so agents working at the same time can't overwrite each other's edits. Its changes are added to your project when Claude merges them, or when you click Merge in the panel.

permission_glow.title: Highlight when Claude waits for you
permission_glow.description: The floating permissions button is highlighted while a question waits for your answer. Off: it stays still. It never moves when your system is set to reduce motion.

highlight.title: Highlight changes on the page
highlight.description: Changed parts of the page are highlighted for a moment.

hover_code.title: Show code on hover
hover_code.description: Hover over a changed part of the page to see its code, old and new, right beside it. Click the card to keep it open.

pick_box.title: Message box next to what you pick
pick_box.description: After you select something on the page, a small box opens next to it for a note. Add puts the note in the panel's message box, where you send it. Off: you type in the panel.

dictation.title: Dictation
dictation.description: Where your voice is turned into text when you press the mic. On this device: on your computer only. Allow online: the browser may send the audio to its maker. Off: no mic button.

follow_page.title: Follow: go to the page being changed
follow_page.description: When Claude edits a file shown on another page of your app, the page goes there.

expand_code_view.title: Expand the code view for new requests
expand_code_view.description: When the code view is made smaller to a narrow bar, it opens again for the first edit of each new request.

wait.title: Wait for page messages
wait.description: After Claude finishes, it keeps waiting a few minutes for a message typed on the page (terminal sessions only).

line_above_prompt.title: Line above the prompt
line_above_prompt.description: Show the EditLens status line above Claude Code's prompt.

theme.title: Panel colors
theme.description: Light, dark, or Auto: the page's own colors, else your computer's.

text_size.title: Panel text size
text_size.description: Text size in the panel and the code view.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: The code editor that Open in the file menu starts. The menu opens from the file name in the code view and from More on an edit card. None hides Open; Copy path and Copy code still work.

auto_connect.title: Connect when Claude Code starts
auto_connect.description: Connect your page when a session starts, so /editlens isn't needed first. Vite projects start their page with EditLens; a plain site (index.html) is served by EditLens itself; other projects are connected when their dev server is already running. Nothing in your project changes.

port.title: Port
port.description: Where the EditLens server listens on this computer. Change it only if 4317 is taken. Takes effect after you restart Claude Code.
